# Base64Decode

Decodes Base64 text back to the text it encodes.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Base64Decode(text)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The Base64 text to decode, in the standard alphabet with `=` padding. Spaces, tabs, carriage returns and line feeds in it are ignored. It must be a string: any other value, null included, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

String. The text whose UTF-8 bytes text encodes. Null when text is not valid Base64, that is when, without the ignored characters, its length is not a multiple of four, it holds a character outside the alphabet, or `=` appears anywhere but in its last one or two places; null too when the decoded bytes are not valid UTF-8. A result that would pass the host's maximum value size is a runtime error.

## Example

`Base64Decode("SGVsbG8=")` returns `"Hello"`.

`Base64Decode("abc")` returns null, so `Base64Decode(input) ?? ""` gives a fallback.
